caption: The drawing depicts a patchwork of hexagonal shapes arranged in a pattern. The hexagons are composed of various solid and patterned colors, including shades of brown, green, red, blue, tan, and beige. In the left center, there's a central hexagon surrounded by concentric rings of darker green-black, red, green, brown, and tan hexagons. To the right, there is another similar cluster, with rings in yellows, blues, and browns, and some pieces show floral or abstract fabric patterns. The upper left and right corners feature strips of tan and blue patchwork, with a section of purple at the top. Some of the surrounding areas are filled with brown, blue, and tan hexagons interspersed with patterned and plain sections. The background is a light tan or beige, framing the patchwork design.
title: Shaker Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
